name: kisvei-library-local
description: The Kisvei Rav Tzadok Library and HaMafteach HaShalem tools, run on this computer: a backup of the online MCP server that works without Cloudflare and keeps an offline copy.
long_description: Runs the same server code as Akiva Publishing's online Kisvei Rav Tzadok Library connector, on this computer. It reads the library published on GitHub Pages (Rav Tzadok's works, the Izhbitz–Radzin works, the Akiva Publishing interlinear editions and HaMafteach HaShalem) and keeps each file it reads in a local cache, so it also works offline with the last copy it saw. Tools: kisvei_search, kisvei_get_text, kisvei_get_contents, kisvei_list_books, kisvei_find_citing_passages, kisvei_get_cited_sources, kisvei_find_parallels, mafteach_find_topic, mafteach_lookup_source, mafteach_lookup_passage, mafteach_search.

tools.name: kisvei_list_books
tools.description: List every book in the library.

tools.name: kisvei_search
tools.description: Full-text search across the library (Hebrew without nikkud, English, headings, notes).
